tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search the StealthStack ARD index for agentic resources (agents, MCP servers, skills, catalogs) discovered across the open web. Free-text query over name/description/tags, ranked by the index's relevance score (best match first). Optionally filter by kind, domain, trust, or accepted payment protocol

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Browse the StealthStack ARD index — agentic resources (agents, MCP servers, skills, catalogs) discovered across the open web. Optionally filter by kind, domain, trust, or accepted payment protocol (paid=x402). Returns a count, a kind breakdown, and the page of resources, each with its connect URL wh

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get the full record for one discovered ARD resource by its identifier (URN), as returned by search_resources / list_resources. Includes the connect URL when the publisher provides one; otherwise the inline connection or pull details. Also returns type, publisher, version, trust, source, description,
